CodeOfConduct.metaDescription: Mĩtugo ya mũcemanio wa AmplifiedAccess na watho wa mĩtugo kũrĩ arĩa marutaga wĩra na arĩa matonyaga.
CodeOfConduct.heroDescription: Wĩtĩkanio witũ kũrĩ mũcemanio ũrĩ mũhingũku, ũtaamũkagĩra, na ũtarĩ na mĩnyamaro kũrĩ andũ othe.
CodeOfConduct.pledgeText1: Ithuĩ ta arĩ a mũcemanio, arutani, na atongoria a AmplifiedAccess, nĩtwĩtĩkĩte gũtũma gũtonya mũcemanio-inĩ witũ gũkorwo ũrĩ ũhoro ũtarĩ na mĩnyamaro kũrĩ andũ othe, tondũ wa mĩaka, ũnene wa mwĩrĩ, ũhinyariku ũrĩa woneka kana ũtoonagwo, mbarĩ, ũrũgamĩrĩri wa mũhũthũ, ũrĩa monagwo na kwĩyonania, kĩrĩro kĩa ũũĩ, thomo, ũthiũrũrũkio wa mũno, bũrũri, kĩonekaine, mbarĩ, gĩkundi, rangi, ndini, kana mũhũthũ na wendi.
CodeOfConduct.pledgeText2: Nĩtwĩtĩkĩte gwĩka na kwaranĩria na njĩra iria irehaga mũcemanio ũrĩ mũhingũku, ũtaamũkagĩra, ũrĩ na ũtũũku, ũtarĩ na kũheenanĩrio, na ũrĩ mũthingu.
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositiveIntro: Ngerekano cia mĩtugo ĩrehaga ũndũ mwega nĩ ta:
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive1: Kuonania tha na wega kũrĩ andũ arĩa angĩ
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive2: Gũtĩĩa maũndũ, mĩoneere, na ũũĩ ũrĩa ũtangĩiganana
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive3: Kũheana na kwĩtĩkĩra na wega ũteithio wa gwaka
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive4: Kwĩtĩkĩra wĩra na kũhoya kĩanjama kũrĩ arĩa mahutĩtio nĩ mahĩtia maitũ, na kwĩruta kuuma ũũĩ-inĩ
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive5: Kũrora kĩrĩa kĩega tiga o kũrĩ ithuĩ ta andũ, no nĩ kũrĩ mũcemanio wothe
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegativeIntro: Ngerekano cia mĩtugo ĩtangĩĩtĩkĩrĩka nĩ ta:
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative1: Kũhũthĩra ciugo kana mbica cia mahoya ma mũhũthũ, na kũhe ũteithio kana kũhota kwa mũhũthũ wa mũthemba o wothe
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative2: Kũnyamarania, ciugo cia kũnyararithia kana cia kũmena, na mĩtĩĩrĩro ya mũndũ mwene kana ya thiini
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative3: Mĩnyamaro ya andũ othe kana ya mwene
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative4: Gũtaũra ũhoro wa mwene wa arĩa angĩ, ta kĩrĩo kana address ya email, hatarĩ na rũthina rũrĩa rũreke
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative5: Mĩtugo ĩngĩ o yothe ĩngĩonwo ta ĩtagĩrĩirwo thĩinĩ wa wĩra
CodeOfConduct.enforcementResponsibilitiesText1: Atongoria a mũcemanio wa AmplifiedAccess nĩ marĩ na wĩra wa gũtaarĩria na kũnyita mĩtugo iitũ ĩrĩa yĩtĩkĩrĩkĩte na nĩmarĩĩkaga ũndũ mwagĩrĩru na wa kĩhooto kũrĩ mĩtugo o ĩrĩa mekona ĩtagĩrĩirwo, ya kũmakia, ya kũnyararithia, kana ya gũtũma ũũru.
CodeOfConduct.enforcementResponsibilitiesText2: Atongoria a mũcemanio marĩ na kĩhooto na wĩra wa kweheria, kũgarũra, kana kũrega ndeto, commits, code, mĩgarũrũku ya wiki, ciũria, na kĩrĩa kĩngĩ kĩheanetwo kĩrĩa gĩtagĩanaine na Watho ũyũ wa Mĩtugo, na nĩmarĩmenyithanagia mataana ma matua ma gũtũũgĩria rĩrĩa kwagĩrĩire.
CodeOfConduct.scopeText: Watho ũyũ wa Mĩtugo ũhũthagĩrio thĩinĩ wa handũ ha mũcemanio hothe, na o na hĩndĩ mũndũ arũgamagĩrĩra na njĩra ya wĩra mũcemanio wa AmplifiedAccess handũ ha andũ othe. Ngerekano cia kũrũgamĩrĩra mũcemanio witũ nĩ kũhũthĩra address ya email ya wĩra, kwandĩka na njĩra ya akaunti ya mĩtandao ya wĩra, kana gwĩka ta mũrũgamĩrĩri wathuurirwo hĩndĩ ya kĩgomano gĩa internet kana gĩtarĩ gĩa internet.
CodeOfConduct.reportingIntro: Maũndũ ma mĩtugo mĩũru, mĩnyamaro, kana ĩngĩ ĩtangĩĩtĩkĩrĩka no marute rũpoti kũrĩ thiritũ ya AmplifiedAccess kũrĩ:
CodeOfConduct.reportingFollowUp: Machayo mothe nĩmakethagĩrĩrio na gũthuthuriwo narua na na kĩhooto. Atongoria othe a mũcemanio nĩ marĩ na wĩra wa gũtĩĩa hitho na ũgitĩri wa mũndũ ũrĩa waheana rũpoti rwa ũndũ o wothe.
CodeOfConduct.guidelinesIntro: Atongoria a mũcemanio nĩmarĩrũmĩrĩra ũtongoria ũyũ hĩndĩ ya gũtua ũrĩa ũngĩgĩa nĩ ũndũ wa wĩra o wothe metaga atĩ nĩ mahĩtia ma Watho ũyũ wa Mĩtugo:
CodeOfConduct.correctionImpactText: Kũhũthĩra ciugo itagĩrĩirwo kana mĩtugo ĩngĩ ĩtonagwo ta ĩtarĩ ya wĩra kana ĩtaamũkagĩrwo thĩinĩ wa mũcemanio.
CodeOfConduct.correctionConsequenceText: Kĩmenyithia gĩa mwene kĩandĩke kuuma kũrĩ atongoria a mũcemanio, kĩrĩa kĩheanaga ũtaũku wĩgiĩ mũthemba wa mahĩtia na gũtaarĩria kĩrĩa gĩtũmĩte mĩtugo ĩtagĩrĩirwo. No kwenderwo kĩanjama kĩa andũ othe.
CodeOfConduct.warningImpactText: Ihĩtia rĩrutĩtwo na ũndũ ũmwe kana mĩtugo mĩingĩ ĩrũmanĩrĩirie.
CodeOfConduct.warningConsequenceText: Kĩmenyithia kĩrĩ na maciaro kũrĩ mĩtugo ĩrĩa ĩthiiaga na mbere. Gũtirĩ ũhoro wa kwaranĩria na andũ arĩa marĩ na thĩna, hamwe na kwaranĩria gũtetetio na arĩa manyitaga Watho wa Mĩtugo, ihinda rĩa mahinda mataarĩirwo. Kwaga kũrũmĩrĩra watho ũyũ no gũtũme kũgĩe na gũthingatwo gwa hĩndĩ kana kwa tene na tene.
CodeOfConduct.temporaryBanImpactText: Ihĩtia inene rĩa mĩtugo ya mũcemanio, hamwe na mĩtugo ĩtagĩrĩirwo ĩrĩa ĩthiiaga na mbere.
CodeOfConduct.temporaryBanConsequenceText: Gũthingatwo kwa hĩndĩ kwa mũthemba o wothe wa kwaranĩria kana ũhoro wa andũ othe na mũcemanio ihinda rĩa mahinda mataarĩirwo. Gũtirĩ kwaranĩria kwa andũ othe kana kwa mwene na arĩa marĩ na thĩna gwĩtĩkĩrĩtwo ihinda-inĩ rĩĩrĩ. Kwaga kũrũmĩrĩra watho ũyũ no gũtũme kũgĩe na gũthingatwo gwa tene na tene.
CodeOfConduct.permanentBanImpactText: Kuonania mũthiĩre wa mahĩtia ma mĩtugo ya mũcemanio, hamwe na mĩtugo ĩtagĩrĩirwo ĩrĩa ĩthiiaga na mbere, mĩnyamaro kũrĩ mũndũ ũmwe, kana kũrũa kana kũnyararithia ikundi cia andũ.
CodeOfConduct.permanentBanConsequenceText: Gũthingatwo gwa tene na tene kwa mũthemba o wothe wa kwaranĩria kwa andũ othe thĩinĩ wa mũcemanio.
CodeOfConduct.attributionText: Watho ũyũ wa Mĩtugo nĩ ũrutĩtwo kuuma <covenantLink>Contributor Covenant</covenantLink>, mũhari wa 2.1, ũrĩa ũrĩ kũrĩ <versionLink>contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct</versionLink>.

Security.metaDescription: Ũrĩa ũngĩheana marũpoti ma ũgwati wa ũgitĩri na wĩra kũrĩ thiritũ ya AmplifiedAccess.
Security.heroDescription: Ũrĩa tũrũgamagĩrĩra marũpoti ma ũgwati na wĩtĩkanio witũ wa kũguũrania ũhoro na wĩra.
Security.intro: AmplifiedAccess nĩĩoyaga ũgitĩri wa WatchTower ta ũndũ mũnene. Nĩtũkenagĩra kĩyo kĩa arutani a ũgitĩri na andũ a mũcemanio arĩa matũteithagia kũiga mũkuru ũrĩ mũgitĩre kũrĩ andũ othe.
Security.reportingWarning: Ndũkanatũme rũpoti rwa ũgwati wa ũgitĩri na njĩra ya ciũria cia GitHub cia andũ othe.
Security.reportingInstruction: Handũ ha ũguo, tũma rũpoti kũrĩ thiritũ itũ na njĩra ya email:
Security.reportingResponseTime: Wagĩrĩirwo nĩ kwamũkĩra macokio thĩinĩ wa mathaa 48. Ũngĩaga kwamũkĩra, ndũrĩrũmĩrĩre na email nĩguo wĩtĩkĩrie atĩ nĩtwamũkĩrire ũhoro waku wa mbere.
Security.whatToIncludeIntro: Nĩguo ũtũteithie gũthuthuria rũpoti rwaku narua, ndũrĩoe ũhoro ũyũ ũrĩa ũngĩhota:
Security.includeItem1: Mũthemba wa ũgwati (ta SQL injection, cross-site scripting, authentication bypass, privilege escalation, na ingĩ)
Security.includeItem2: Njĩra iria nene cia faili cia mũthingi iria ihutanĩtio na ũgwati
Security.includeItem3: Handũ code yagĩte — branch, commit hash, kana URL yumĩte thĩ
Security.includeItem4: Ũthondeku o wothe ũrĩa ũbataraine kũonania rĩngĩ ũgwati
Security.includeItem5: Ũrutani wa ikinya na ikinya wa kuonania rĩngĩ ũgwati
Security.includeItem6: Ũira wa mũbango kana code ya exploit, kũngĩhoteka
Security.includeItem7: Ũhutia wa ũgwati, hamwe na ũrĩa mũrimũ angĩhũthĩra
Security.disclosurePolicy: AmplifiedAccess ĩrũmagĩrĩra ũhoro wa <link>Kũguũrania Ũgwati na Njĩra Ĩnyitanĩrĩirie</link>. Nĩtũkũũrĩrie ũtũhe ihinda rĩa kwĩrigiicania na gũthondeka ũgwati ũrĩa waheanwo rũpoti mbere ya kũguũrania kũrĩ andũ othe.
Security.disclosureFollowUp: Nĩtũrĩkũmenyithagia ũrĩa tũratũũgĩria thĩinĩ wa gũthuthuria na tũkũheana gĩtĩĩo kĩa ũthondeki waku kũngĩenda.
Security.languageText: Nĩtũendaga ũhoro wothe wa ũgitĩri ũkorwo ũrĩ na Gĩthungũ.

About.heroDescription: WatchTower nĩ mũkuru wa ũũgĩ wa gĩthaka ũrĩa ũrũgamĩte na mĩcemanio na ũhũthagĩra AI na ũtaalamu wa thiomi cia gĩthaka nĩguo ũhotithie andũ kũheana marũpoti ma mahitũko, ũgwati, na mahĩtia ma kĩhooto na rũthiomi rwao mwene, na ũgarũraga marũpoti macio matuĩke ũmenyo ũngĩtũmĩka nĩ ũndũ wa ũrũgamĩrĩri na macokio.
About.objectiveDescription: Kũmenyerera atĩ mũndũ o wothe arĩ na hinya wa kũheana marũpoti ma mathĩna ma gĩthaka na rũthiomi rũrĩa aragia, nĩguo gũtikagĩe na mũgambo ũtaiguĩkaga na o mũndũ ahote gũtonya kũrũgamĩrĩra arĩa marĩ na wĩra.
About.languagesDescription: WatchTower rĩu nĩĩheanaga ũteithio wa thiomi {count} ĩgĩtũma mĩgambo mĩingĩ ya mĩcemanio ĩtonye, ĩiguuo na ĩteithĩrĩrie ũrũgamĩrĩri wa andũ othe na rũthiomi rũrĩa mona nĩ rwa gũtũma mũno.
About.safetyDescription: Nĩtũũĩ atĩ kwaria kũngĩrehe ũgwati. Ũũ nĩguo WatchTower yakĩtwo ya kũgitĩra.
About.faqIdentityQuestion: Nĩ ũrũgamĩrĩri wakwa nĩ ũgitĩirwo rĩrĩa ndũma rũpoti?
About.faqIdentityAnswer: Ndũbatairio gũheana rĩĩtwa rĩaku, namba ya thimũ, kana ũhoro o wothe ũrĩa ũngĩtũmanũrĩrio nĩguo ũtũme rũpoti. Kwaga kũmenyeka nĩguo mũtaratara wa ma, ti ũndũ ũtangĩmenyerwo.
About.faqAccountAnswer: Nĩ gũtirĩ gĩthabũ kĩa gũthondeka kana gũtonya kũrũmĩrĩrwo. Nĩũũkaga, ũgatũma rũpoti, ũgathiĩ. Gũtirĩ ũndũ ũkũnyitanagia na rũpoti rwaku.
About.faqEncryptionAnswer: Marũpoti mothe nĩmahithagwo kuuma ihinda rĩrĩa ũratũma. Rũpoti rwaku rũtingĩnyitwo kana rũcokio kũrĩ we hĩndĩ ya gũtwarwo.
About.faqVisibilityAnswer: Marũpoti nĩmethagĩrĩrio nĩ arũgamĩrĩri a WatchTower metĩkĩrĩkĩte. Rũpoti rwaku rũtirĩ hĩndĩ rũheanagwo kũrĩ andũ othe na ũhoro ũngĩmenyithania.
About.faqDeviceQuestion: Nĩngũhota gũtũma rũpoti kuuma kĩndũ kĩngĩgaĩrwo kana kĩa andũ othe?
About.faqDeviceAnswer: Ĩĩ. WatchTower ndĩigaga ũhoro wa sesheni kana cookies iria ihutanĩtio na rũpoti rwaku. Gũtũma rũpoti kuuma kĩndũ kĩngĩgaĩrwo ndĩgũkũrehagĩra ũgwati.
About.ctaDescription: Tũma rũpoti rwa mathĩna ma gĩthaka na rũthiomi rwaku. Gũtirĩ gĩthabũ kĩbataire, gũtirĩ ũhoro waku mwene ũbataire.

Home.heroDescription: Rĩrĩa mĩcemanio ĩngĩhota kwaria, maũndũ nĩmagarũrũkaga. Watchtower nĩĩhotithagia andũ kũheana marũpoti ma mathĩna ma gĩthaka na mahĩtia ma kĩhooto na rũthiomi rũrĩa maragia, nĩguo o mũndũ ahote gũtonya wĩra-inĩ wa gĩthaka na ũrũgamĩrĩri wa andũ othe.
Home.howItWorksDescription: Kuuma rũpoti rũmwe nginya kũgarũrũka kũnene, ũũ nĩguo WatchTower ĩhotithagia mĩcemanio kũiguuo na kũrehe ũgarũrũku ũrĩ na bata.
Home.step1Description: Nĩtũheanaga ũtaalamu ũrĩa ũteithagĩrĩria andũ na mĩcemanio kũheana marũpoti ma mathĩna ma gĩthaka kana mahĩtia ma kĩhooto kuuma thimũ kana kombiũta yao na rũthiomi rũrĩa maragia.
Home.step2Description: Nĩtwĩkaga na tũkĩgwatĩrĩria rũpoti o rũmwe, tũgĩthondeka mahitũko mepe-inĩ na kuonania mĩthiĩre ĩrĩa ĩngĩaga kũmenyeka. Ũhoro ũtathondeketwo ũtuĩkaga ũmenyo mũthingu na mũthondekeku ũrĩa ũheanaga ũhoro mũnene.
Home.step3Description: Mĩcemanio, thiritũ, na thĩinĩ ciamũrĩ ĩyũkagia ũmenyo ũyũ nĩguo ciake maũndũ, ciĩkĩrĩre arĩa marĩ na wĩra thĩinĩ wa kĩhooto, na ithũkũmagie ũgarũrũku ũrĩ na bata, ũtũĩkĩte na ũira wa ma kuuma thĩ.

Home.faqsDescription: Learn more about reporting, languages, privacy and how WatchTower helps make community information useful.
Home.faq1Answer: WatchTower is a multilingual reporting and civic intelligence tool that enables people to report local issues and rights violations in the languages they speak. Reports can then be organised, mapped and analysed to help reveal patterns and support action.
Home.faq2Question: What can I report on WatchTower?
Home.faq2Answer: You can report incidents such as rights violations, safety concerns and other civic issues happening in your community — anything others should know about or that could help inform action.
Home.faq3Question: Can I report in my own language?
Home.faq3Answer: Yes. You can report by voice or text in the language you're most comfortable using, and WatchTower helps transcribe, translate and structure your report so it can be understood across languages.
Home.faq4Question: Can I submit a report anonymously?
Home.faq4Answer: Yes. Anonymous is the default, not the exception — you never need to provide your name or any identifying information to file a report.
Home.faq5Question: What happens after I submit a report?
Home.faq5Answer: Every report is processed and verified, mapped alongside others to surface patterns, and shared with communities, organizations and institutions who can act on it.
